abstract: Ki-1 (CD30) antigen expression has been considered to be restricted to hematopoietic tissues including the recently described anaplastic large cell lymphoma and Reed-Sternberg (RS) cells in Hodgkin's disease. Its presence on some activated lymphocytes in non-neoplastic lymphoid tissues has been used as evidence that such cells might represent the physiologic counterpart of RS cells. In this study expression of CD30 antigen in 117 nonhematopoietic tumors was investigated using monoclonal antibody Ber-H2. The antigen was regularly expressed in frozen section (strongly) and paraffin section (less strongly) by embryonal carcinomas (8 of 10 studied) and the embryonal elements of mixed germ cell tumors (4 of 4), but not in other types of germ cell tumors (0 of 11) or nonhematopoietic tumors (0 of 92). Normal adult, neonatal, and fetal testes were negative for CD30 antigen, as were other fetal tissues and placenta. Ki-1 antibody gives similar results in frozen section. These findings have implications for theories suggesting an origin of RS cells from activated lymphocytes. They are also important for determining the diagnostic significance of CD30 positivity in a tumor of unknown origin, and suggest possible new uses for CD30 antibodies in routine diagnostic immunohistology.
abstract_ja: Ki-1（CD30）抗原の発現は、未分化大細胞型リンパ腫およびホジキン病のReed-Sternberg細胞など造血組織に限られると考えられてきた。本研究では、モノクローナル抗体Ber-H2を用い、117例の非造血系腫瘍におけるCD30抗原の発現を検討した。抗原は胎児性癌（10例中8例）および混合型胚細胞腫瘍の胎児性成分（4例中4例）で恒常的に発現した（凍結切片では強陽性、パラフィン切片ではやや弱陽性）。他の胚細胞腫瘍（11例中0例）および非造血系腫瘍（92例中0例）では陰性であった。正常成人、新生児、胎児の精巣、その他の胎児組織および胎盤は陰性であった。Ki-1抗体も凍結切片で同様の結果を示した。これらの知見は、Reed-Sternberg細胞が活性化リンパ球に由来するという説に関連するほか、起源不明の腫瘍におけるCD30陽性の診断的意義を明らかにし、ルーチンの免疫組織学におけるCD30抗体の新たな用途を示唆する。
